title: FortiClient vulnerabilities
leadParagraph: Fortinet has released security updates to address multiple vulnerabilities in FortiClient for Windows and Linux. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system or access sensitive information.
contentHtml:
Fortinet has released security updates to address multiple vulnerabilities in FortiClient for Windows and Linux. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system or access sensitive information.

TT-CSIRT encourages users/administrators to review the following releases from Fortinet and apply the necessary updates:

  1. FortiClient (Windows) – Privilege Escalation
  2. FortiClient (Linux) – Improper Directories Permissions
  3. FortiClient (Linux) – external access to confighandler webserver
